user.title: Connect to Incus
user.description: How should Home Assistant reach your Incus server?

https.title: Incus server address
https.description: The server must listen on the network: `incus config set core.https_address :8443`.

auth.title: Authenticate
auth.description: Server certificate fingerprint (verify it against `incus info`): `{fingerprint}`

menu_options.token: Create a client certificate with a trust token (recommended)

token.title: Trust token
token.description: Run `incus config trust add home-assistant` on the server and paste the token it prints. Home Assistant generates its own client certificate and registers it.

existing.title: Client certificate
existing.description: PEM client certificate and key already trusted by the server (`incus config trust add-certificate`).

unix.title: Unix socket
unix.description: Path of the Incus socket as seen by Home Assistant (the socket must be mounted into the container if HA runs in one).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Incus server: {error}
error.invalid_token: The server rejected the trust token (expired or already used): {error}
error.not_trusted: Connected, but the server does not trust this client certificate (auth={error}).
